info.title: Ship Public API
info.description:
The public, versioned Ship API (PLUGFORGE.MD §2.1/§2.4) — distinct from the
internal `/api/*` surface documented at `/api/openapi.json`. Every
resource here is a typed view over the unified `documents` table.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except `GET /health` and `GET /openapi.json` requires a
bearer token: an OAuth access token or a scoped personal access token. See
`bearerAuth` below.

## Errors

Every failure response uses one shape (PLUGFORGE.MD §2.5):

```
{ code, message, details?, request_id }
```

## Pagination

List endpoints return `{ data, next_cursor }`. `next_cursor` is an opaque,
keyset-based cursor — pass it back verbatim as `?cursor=` for the next page;
`null` means there is no next page.

bearerAuth.description: A public API bearer token: either an OAuth access token (PF-104, PLUGFORGE.MD §2.2 oauth_tokens) or a scoped personal access token (api_tokens.scopes, PF-107). GET /api/v1/me introspects the authenticated principal (PF-201).

details.description: Additional error context. Shape varies by code — e.g. validation_failed carries fieldErrors, forbidden carries missing_scope.

request_id.description: Correlates this response with the server-side log line for the same request.

content.description: TipTap JSON document content (not the Yjs binary collaboration state, which stays internal-only). Null when visibility is 'private' and the caller is not the document's creator.

visibility.description: 'private' or 'workspace'. NOTE (CodeRabbit finding, TRO-605): this route does not currently gate on visibility for most fields — id/title/document_type/properties/visibility/created_by/timestamps are returned for any document in the caller's workspace regardless of this value (a pre-existing, disclosed gap, see resources/documents.ts). Only `content` is actually restricted: it is null for a 'private' document the caller did not create.

created_by.description: User id of the document creator, or null.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this document (e.g. an issue) was marked done, or null.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.
Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

id.description: The id of the document that links to this one.

display_id.description: e.g. '#42' for an issue; null for other document types.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

comment_id.description: Thread identifier (matches the TipTap comment mark).

author.description: null if the author's user row no longer exists.

Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

workspace_sprint_start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the workspace's sprint-cadence anchor date.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — this sprint's own computed calendar start date.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — this sprint's own computed calendar end date (inclusive).

app_id.description: The oauth_apps id this subscription belongs to.

secret.description: The plaintext whsec_... signing secret. Returned exactly once — this response is the only place it ever appears; it is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and cannot be recovered via any subsequent API call.

warning.description: Human-readable reminder to save the secret now.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

subscription_id.description: The webhook_subscriptions id this attempt belongs to.

event_id.description: The event this attempt delivers. Shared across every attempt (same attempt_number series) of the same logical delivery.

idempotency_key.description: Stable across every attempt of the same logical delivery — the value sent in the Idempotency-Key header.

attempt_number.description: 1-indexed attempt number for this logical delivery. A retried delivery has multiple rows sharing event_id, one per attempt_number.

status.description: This attempt's own state: pending (scheduled, not yet executed), success (2xx), failed (5xx/timeout, a retry was scheduled), or dead (permanent failure — 4xx, or the 6th failed attempt).

response_status.description: The subscriber's HTTP response status, or null if this attempt never got a response (still pending, or a network/timeout failure).

response_excerpt.description: Up to 2000 characters of the subscriber's response body, or null if there was none.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency for this attempt in milliseconds, or null if it never completed.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next retry is due (only meaningful on a failed row with a pending sibling), or null if this attempt is terminal (success/dead) or itself still pending execution.

replayed_from_id.description: The id of the delivery row this attempt replayed, if it was created by POST /deliveries/{id}/replay (PF-306). Null for every row created by the normal delivery pipeline (a fresh delivery or one of its own automatic retries).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp this attempt row was created (its own enqueue time).

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

request_id.description: The request_id assigned to the audited call (X-Request-Id).

app_client_id.description: The calling oauth_apps.client_id, or null for a personal-token call or an unauthenticated request.

user_id.description: The calling user id, or null for a Client Credentials call or an unauthenticated request.

method.description: HTTP method of the audited call.

route.description: The literal request path (no query string) of the audited call.

scope_used.description: The scope requireScope(...) checked for this route, or null for a route with no scope requirement.

status.description: HTTP response status of the audited call.

latency_ms.description: Server-side latency of the audited call, in milliseconds.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the audit row was written.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

user_id.description: Linked users.id, or null for a pending/unlinked person.

reports_to.description: The manager's USER id, or null if none is recorded.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page (pass back as ?cursor=), or null when this is the last page.

ISO 8601 timestamp — pass back as ?since= on the next poll. Cursor-lagged: never advanced past (now - 5s), so a slower in-flight transaction cannot be permanently missed. See resources/changes.ts for the full mechanism.

truncated.description: True per category if that category hit the limit and rows remain for a later poll.

get.description: Public, unauthenticated liveness check for the /api/v1 surface (PF-001).
The generated OpenAPI 3.1 document describing every route on /api/v1 (PF-202). Public, no auth.
Cursor-paginated list of documents in the caller's workspace (PF-200), optionally filtered by document_type. Requires the documents:read scope.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

post.description: Creates a document in the caller's workspace. title is required at this public surface — unlike the internal API, which defaults it to "Untitled" (PF-200 AC-4). Requires the documents:write scope.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

get.description: Fetch a single document by id within the caller's workspace. A malformed or non-existent id both produce a not_found error (PF-200 test design AC-4). Requires the documents:read scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

patch.description: Overwrites a document's content field (PF-703, TRO-435) — a deliberately narrow update surface (content only, no title/properties, no document_type filter). Built for the agent gate's sdk-mode write path (GateShipClient.setStandupContent). Requires the documents:write scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Cursor-paginated associations FROM this document (document_id = {id}). Deliberately excludes the joined related document's title/type — re-fetch each related_id via GET /documents/{id} to check access before trusting it. Requires the documents:read scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Cursor-paginated associations pointing AT this document (related_id = {id}) — e.g. every issue in a sprint. Same title/type-leak avoidance as /associations. Requires the documents:read scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.summary: List documents that link to this document
get.description: Cursor-paginated documents whose content links to this one (document_links, scoped to the caller's workspace). Requires the documents:read scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Cursor-paginated comments on this document, oldest-page-first by created_at descending (same keyset order as every other v1 list). Requires the documents:read scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No document with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of issue-typed documents in the caller's workspace (PF-201), with state/priority/assignee_id lifted to top-level typed fields. Optionally filtered by ?assignee_id= (PF-205, TRO-414). Requires the issues:read scope.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

patch.summary: Apply a state transition to an issue
patch.description: Updates an issue's state field (PF-703, TRO-435) — a deliberately narrow update surface (state only; no title/priority/assignee_id/belongs_to, no "incomplete children" confirmation gate — see UpdateIssueRequestSchema's own doc comment). Built for the agent gate's sdk-mode write path (GateShipClient.applyIssueTransition). Requires the issues:write scope.

schema.description: Document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No issue with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of sprint-typed documents in the caller's workspace (PF-201). Requires the sprints:read scope.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

get.summary: Get a sprint by id, with cadence/week-dates
get.description: Fetch a single sprint-typed document by id, extended with sprint_number/owner_id/status and the computed start_date/end_date calendar window (from the workspace's sprint_start_date anchor). A malformed or non-existent id both produce a not_found error, matching resources/documents.ts's GET /:id convention. Requires the sprints:read scope.

schema.description: Sprint document id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

404.description: No sprint with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.description: Identity introspection for the calling bearer token (PF-201): { user, app, scopes }. Requires a valid bearer token but, deliberately, no specific scope — see resources/me.ts for the rationale.

post.description: Creates a subscription for app_id to event_type deliveries at target_url, generates a whsec_... signing secret, and returns it in plaintext exactly once. The secret is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and cannot be retrieved again — save it now. app_id must belong to the caller's own workspace. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

201.description: The created subscription, including the plaintext secret (shown exactly once).

400.description: Invalid request body, or app_id does not reference an app in the caller's workspace.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of webhook subscriptions belonging to apps in the caller's workspace. Never includes the signing secret (plaintext or ciphertext). Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

get.description: Cursor-paginated delivery log: one row per delivery ATTEMPT (a retried delivery leaves multiple rows, one per attempt_number, sharing event_id), scoped to subscriptions belonging to apps in the caller's workspace. Filterable by subscription_id and status. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (a malformed, non-UUID subscription_id, or a status value outside pending/success/failed/dead) or an invalid cursor. A well-formed but unrecognized or cross-workspace subscription_id is NOT an error — it matches nothing and returns 200 with an empty data page (same fail-closed convention as the rest of this resource).

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

post.description: Re-runs a logged delivery through the deliverer, carrying the ORIGINAL Idempotency-Key — never a freshly generated one, so a correctly-implemented subscriber recognizes it as the same logical delivery. Works regardless of the original delivery's status, including dead (DLQ) rows. Creates a NEW delivery row (never mutates the original), linked back to it via replayed_from_id. A 201 response means the row was created, not that the subscriber accepted it — see the response schema's own status field. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

schema.description: Delivery attempt id (a row from GET /webhooks/deliveries). A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

201.description: The new delivery row created by this replay. A 201 means the row was created and an attempt ran to completion (or was durably recorded as still pending, if the attempt itself failed to execute) — it does NOT mean the subscriber accepted the delivery. Read the row's own status field (success, failed, dead, or pending) for the actual outcome.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

404.description: No delivery with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.summary: Get a webhook subscription by id
get.description: Fetch a single webhook subscription by id, scoped to the caller's workspace. Never includes the signing secret. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

schema.description: Webhook subscription id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

404.description: No subscription with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

delete.description: Deactivates the subscription (active = false) rather than deleting the row, so a future delivery log can still reference it. Idempotent: deactivating an already-inactive subscription still returns 204. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

schema.description: Webhook subscription id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

204.description: The subscription was deactivated (or was already inactive).

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

404.description: No subscription with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

post.summary: Rotate a webhook subscription's signing secret
post.description: Generates a new whsec_... signing secret, returns it in plaintext exactly once, and overwrites the stored ciphertext in place — no grace period (same precedent as PF-102's OAuth app-secret rotation): the old secret stops validating new HMAC signatures immediately. Requires the webhooks:manage scope.

schema.description: Webhook subscription id. A non-UUID value 404s rather than validation-failing.

200.description: The subscription, including the new plaintext secret (shown exactly once).

403.description: The bearer token lacks the webhooks:manage scope.

404.description: No subscription with this id exists in the caller's workspace, or the id is malformed.

get.summary: List the public API audit trail
get.description: Cursor-paginated log of every /api/v1 call (PLUGFORGE.MD §2.7): request_id, app client_id, user_id, method, route, scope checked, status, and latency. Admin/owner-scoped: requires the audit:read scope AND the caller to be a workspace admin, a platform super-admin ("owner"), or a first-party app credential. A workspace admin sees only their own workspace's rows; a super-admin sees every workspace. Optional ?app_client_id= filters to one app.

200.description: A page of public API audit rows.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the audit:read scope, OR it holds the scope but the caller is neither a workspace admin, a platform super-admin, nor a first-party app credential (resources/audit.ts's "admin/owner-scoped" design).

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of person-typed documents (the team directory) in the caller's workspace. Requires the documents:read scope — people are documents in Ship's unified document model (PLUGFORGE.MD §4 PF-205).

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.

get.description: A pull-based, cursor-lagged change feed over documents/document_history/comments in the caller's workspace — distinct from webhooks (which push deliveries). since is required; pass the previous response's next_cursor as the next since. Requires the documents:read scope.

400.description: Invalid or missing since, or since is in the future.

403.description: The bearer token lacks the required scope.
